name: govbot-uk
description: Govbot UK is a Discord bot developed by [ToastedCheesyBeans](https://github.com/ToastedCheesyBeans) and [Jacob-Walton](https://github.com/Jacob-Walton). The bot is designed to provide up to date news from a variety of UK news agency's about political events. The bot also provides a wealthy amount of information about ongoings in parliament such as events, bills and debates.

scripts.docker:start: npm run docker:setup && docker compose up -d && del .env.local

author: ToastedCheesyBeans, Jacob-Walton
